title: Spray-applied fire-resistant materials.
officialText:
The provisions in this section apply to structural steel beams and girders protected with spray-applied fire-resistant materials. Larger or smaller beam and girder shapes shall be permitted to be substituted for beams specified in approved unrestrained or restrained fire-resistance-rated assemblies provided that the thickness of the fire-resistant material is adjusted in accordance with the following expression:

h = [ { (W / D ) + 0.60 } / { ( W / D ) + 0.60}] h (Equation 7-17) 2 1 1 2 2 1

where: h = Thickness of spray-applied fire-resistant material in inches. W = Weight of the structural steel beam or girder in pounds per linear foot. D = Heated perimeter of the structural steel beam or girder in inches. Subscript 1 refers to the beam and fire-resistant material thickness in the approved assembly. Subscript 2 refers to the substitute beam or girder and the required thickness of fire-resistant material.
Exception: The fire resistance of structural steel beams and girders protected with intumescent or mastic fire-resistant coatings shall be determined on the basis of fire-resistance tests in accordance with Section 703.2. W/D RATIOS FOR STEEL COLUMNS PROPERTIES OF CONCRETE
